submittedPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one full desktop DooKnow owner applications homepage, about 1440x1000. Image 1 is the exact existing apps content, layout, controls and unpinned state authority. Image 2 supplies only unified DooKnow book/header hierarchy, compact flat palette and density. Add horizontal global header DooKnow book identity | 应用. Keep narrow owner rail O account, 笔记, 最近, 收藏, 应用 selected, bottom 回收站/设置. Apps has NO notebook/search/tree sidebar; main begins after the rail. Do not add app-management/navigation controls.
Preserve eyebrow YOUR WORKSPACE, EXTENDED; title 应用; description 让知识走得更远。为你的笔记，打开新的可能。 Three equal cards, in order: 知识图谱, 博客, To Doo. Each retains its actual source icon, 原生应用 badge, description, decorative preview, summary and arrow. 知识图谱 description 从原文发现概念与关系，沿着证据探索知识。; summary 自动分析 · 关系证据 · 局部探索. 博客 description 把值得分享的笔记，变成你的个人博客。; summary 选稿 · 预览 · 手动发布. To Doo description 带着资料做事，把每一步成果留下来。; summary 目标 · 任务 · 日程 · 专注. The To Doo name belongs only to this existing application card; platform identity stays DooKnow. Under ALL three cards the action is ＋ 加入左侧菜单, matching actual unpinned baseline. No pinned shortcuts in owner rail. Keep bottom lock footnote 资料与应用数据由你掌握，公开分享由你决定。 No app interiors, new app, install, search, edit, notification or toast. Flat white, pale #f7f8fa, #e6e9f1 borders, #272b3a text, #657084 muted, #4566c6 blue, #edf1ff selected, compact clean sans-serif and small line icons. No texture/gradient or browser chrome. Source/state caption belongs in metadata.

functionalInvariants: Every input constraint, action guard and important-state contract below is required. This plan is not a claim that incompatible states coexist or that source-only states ran.
Owner navigation may use the existing ToDoo two-level hierarchy; public guest and standalone reading may not contain private chrome.
STATE WS-084: Local storage unavailable warning via toast

POLICY Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.
WS-084: Blog and ToDoo interiors explicitly excluded.

UI structure rather than backend state count determines bitmap jobs. StateCoverage names exact component/bindings/guards and compact matrix rows; shared-pattern is not a claim that incompatible alternatives were visually proven together.

allowedActions.label: 应用卡片
allowedActions.effect: Open existing blog, ToDoo or graph app
allowedActions.guard: Owner session; control-specific guards described in permissionRules.

allowedActions.label: 加入左侧菜单 / 从左侧菜单移除
allowedActions.guard: Workspace reports persistence failure as toast

selfInspection.method: Actual native generated preview viewed against the actual matching baseline, source and viewed PILOT-WS-001.
concerns: Bitmap cannot verify owner enforcement, source action execution, busy guards, keyboard/focus, resize or responsive fit.
Light raster texture and approximate dimensions remain illustrative; eventual code must use flat shared CSS tokens.
selectedBaselineState=unpinned intentionally reflects actual baseline; pinned/unpinned alternate source actions remain mapped by WS-084 but are not simultaneously shown.
To Doo appears solely as an existing application card name, not platform branding or app interior.
